definition: The closing move of any strategic synthesis: the last thing the operator reads after a brand read, an audience map, an angle batch, a perf audit.
target: Facts, then expert reading, then proactive motion. The close shows the factual state (good, especially after a scrape, and listing the unknowns is good), interprets it (the expert contextual reading: the dominant wall, the second-order consequence; skipping this layer is the weather report), then moves forward (proposes the next step(s) carried by the reading: one strong recommendation or several context-appropriate directions with a lean, never a passive symmetric menu). It keeps the observed/deduced rigor (no hypothesis stated as fact) and gates at most one question, only when unknowable from the data AND blocking the next paying step. The weather report (failure) = stop at the facts, no interpretation, then hand the operator a passive question. Showing facts is not the failure; the missing reading plus the passive hand-off is.
supersedes: investigation-posture.md Section 5 (Close ouvert = une question macro où l'opérateur arbitre) and AP-5. The mapping (Observé/Déduit/Inconnu/Leviers) stays; the close stops being an outsourced question and becomes a defended verdict-on-move. The doctrine is amended to match this target in the same body of work.

criteria.pass: Interprets the facts: names what they MEAN in context (the dominant wall, the second-order consequence, the contextual expert reading), not just what was found.
criteria.fail: Shows the facts/state with no interpretation. The reader learns what is, never what it means. This is the weather report.

criteria.pass: Moves forward: proposes the next step(s) carried by the reading. One strong recommendation, or several context-appropriate directions with a clear lean. The agent leads.
criteria.fail: Passive hand-off: a flat symmetric menu ('lequel veux-tu creuser ?'), or stops at the unknowns, or asks the operator to choose with no lean. No forward motion.

criteria.pass: The factual état des lieux is present and the reading rests on it (especially after a scrape). Grounded in what was actually found.
criteria.fail: Opinion from thin air, or facts hidden. No factual basis the reader can check.

criteria.pass: Hypotheses carry their confidence and are not asserted as facts; the reading is defended on the strongest available evidence while naming what is still unknown.
criteria.fail: States a deduced hypothesis (audience, ROAS, driver) as established fact. Confident prose with no provenance.

criteria.pass: Zero or one question that genuinely blocks the next step (unknowable from data AND on the critical path). Everything else proceeds degraded-but-honest.
criteria.fail: Two or more questions the operator must answer before anything moves. Setup-by-interrogation.
